name: I greet you all
description: Formal-looking Nigerian group greeting: a man in a hall of suited people, caption 'I greet you all Group members'. Comic 'chairman enters the meeting' energy for saying hello to a whole WhatsApp group.
whenToUse: Use in group chats when greeting everyone at once, joining a room, saying good morning/afternoon/evening to the group, or opening with mock-official respect. Fits 'hello group', 'good morning everyone', first message after being added, or when the bot is addressing all members. Prefer groups over 1:1. Pair with a short hello; do not explain the sticker.
whenNotToUse: Skip in DMs, sad news, arguments, or dry technical questions. Do not use it as a political comment. Not for a single person unless they asked to greet the group.
